Container.Name: Optimizarr
Container.Overview: Automated media library optimizer with Intel QSV / VAAPI hardware-accelerated transcoding. Monitors your media libraries, queues encoding jobs, and replaces source files with smaller, re-encoded versions — all from a single container.
Container.Description: Automated media library optimizer with Intel QSV / VAAPI hardware-accelerated transcoding. Monitors your media libraries, queues encoding jobs, and replaces source files with smaller, re-encoded versions — all from a single container.

Volume.Name: Cache
Volume.Description: Temporary workspace used during encoding. Should be on a fast drive.

Variable.Name: LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME
Variable.Description: VA-API driver name. Use iHD for Intel Gen 8+ (recommended) or i965 for older hardware.

Variable.Name: QSV_DEVICE
Variable.Description: Path to the Intel render device used for QSV hardware encoding.

Variable.Name: OPTIMIZARR_UI_USERNAME
Variable.Description: Optional: username for basic authentication on the web UI. Leave blank to disable auth.

Variable.Name: OPTIMIZARR_UI_PASSWORD
Variable.Description: Optional: password for basic authentication on the web UI. Leave blank to disable auth.
